place.name: Sarektjåkkå
place.description: Sarektjåkkå (Swedish: [ˈsɑ̌ːrɛkˌɕɔkːɔ]) is the second highest mountain in Sweden and the highest mountain in the Laponian area at 2,089 metres (6,854 ft) AMSL. However its mountain peak is the 3:rd highest mountain peak in Sweden, because the two highest peaks in Sweden belongs to the mountain Kebnekaise at 2,097 (North Summit) and 2090 meters (South Summit). The mountain is located close to the eastern border of Sarek National Park, about 23 kilometres (14 mi) southwest of Suorva.
